data_fields.name: caster_level
data_fields.donor_constant: m_lev (monster level); tier roll is rn2(m_lev)

data_fields.name: tier_reroll_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: if roll > top, reroll rn2(top) unless rn2(top) is 0

data_fields.name: fumble_threshold
data_fields.donor_constant: rn2(m_lev x 10) < 20 (100 when confused); donor fix: min(20, m_lev x 5)

data_fields.name: breath_fire_chance
data_fields.donor_constant: rn2(3) != 0 (2 in 3) when lined up and off cooldown

data_fields.name: breath_cooldown_set_chance_vs_hero
data_fields.donor_constant: 1 in 3 (rn2(3) == 0) when the target is the hero; always otherwise

data_fields.name: sleep_breath_extra_cooldown
data_fields.donor_constant: rnd(20) ticks added vs hero without sleep resistance

best_idea: Pick a boss ability from a roll capped by its level, take the strongest usable one at or below the roll, and set a level-scaled cooldown after each use, so tiers are readable without a script.
decision_why: Keep the level-gated tier pick, the tiered lists and the level-scaled cooldown; fix the donor fumble rule, which always fumbles at monster level 1-2 (so those casters never cast), because a boss tier ladder must work at every level.
acceptance: A server test with a level-4 caster over 100 picks never chooses a tier 4+ ability; a level-1 caster fumbles at most 50% of casts; in fight a level-4 boss shows tier 0-3 abilities only, with a 6-tick cooldown after each cast.
